sources.title: Introducing LFM2.5: The Next Generation of On-Device AI — Blog
sources.snippet: Today, we're excited to announce the LFM2.5-1.2B model family, our most capable release yet for edge AI deployment. It builds on the LFM2 device-optimized architecture and represents a significant leap forward in building reliable agents on the edge.

sources.title: coreai-model-zoo/models/lfm2.5-vl/README.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: The smallest VLM in this catalog by a factor of three, and its detail-tier sibling. Core AI ports of LiquidAI/LFM2.5-VL-450M and -3B: image + text → text on the pipelined-engine fast path. Which one: the 450M (658 MB, iPhone-gated at 112 tok/s) is the one that fits beside an app — every other VLM here starts at ~2 GB resident.

sources.title: coreai-model-zoo/models/lfm2.5/README.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: Community model zoo for Apple Core AI (iOS/macOS 27): 49 models — LLM, VLM, OCR, ASR, TTS, image/video/music gen, forecasting — converted, verified on real devices, downloadable from Hugging Face, and runnable in one line of Swift via CoreAIKit.

sources.title: LiquidAI/LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct | vLLM Recipes - recipes.vllm.ai
sources.snippet: Liquid AI's 1.2B instruction-tuned model on the LFM2 hybrid conv+attention backbone, with tool calling and a 32K context window on a single small GPU.
